notes.title: v0.48.3 - Server Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Joining servers mid-game[/h2]
Public servers can now be joined mid-game instead of only in the lobby, you can also see which map a server is in in the server list.

When creating a server you can also choose to disable joining mid-game, it's enabled by default.

There may be some data that is not yet properly replicated to the spectator when they join mid-game, should you encounter any replication issues please report it so I can fix them quickly! This should not have an effect on gameplay.

[h2]Balancing adjustments[/h2]
The Geiger Counter has been nerfed a bit, the indicator moves a bit more slowly and its range has been decreased.

The Flashbangs have been buffed, their light now lasts a lot longer.

[h2]Known issue[/h2]
There are issues when using a controller in the main menu, this is a priority and will be fixed very soon.

[b]Change list:[/b]
[list]
🎉 Public servers can now be joined mid-game as spectator
🎉 You can invite friends to join a server mid-game as spectator
🎉 You can now see which map a server is currently in
🎉 Added a button in the main menu with links to social media and a bug report form
🎮 The Geiger Counter has been nerfed (range and accuracy decreased)
🎮 The Flashbangs have been buffed (light flash lasts longer)
🔧 Added a setting to allow or turn off joining as spectator

[/list]

notes.title: v0.42.2 - Modulators, Emotes and more
notes.content:
[h2]New color grading[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020566/00b5224eeab810bb60c0a03b26fe6cbf578d78e3.png[/img]
I've put a lot of thought into this and have decided to rework the color grading of the entire game, especially in the shadows.

Shadows are now much darker and the game is overall slightly less saturated, for people who prefer the old look there is now an optional Modulator you can enable (called Moonlit Night Modulator) to switch it back to the old color grading!

Let me know what you think of the new look, I'm hoping this update will make the game feel more like a horror game and be scarier overall.

[h2]Modulators[/h2] 
Modulators are a brand new feature, you can enable Modulators in the game setup screen.

They can affect the game in various ways and can all be combined!

[b]Mirror:[/b] Mirrors the entire map
[b]Shrinked Humans:[/b] Humans are about half their normal size
[b]Shuffle Abilities:[/b] The monster gets a new random ability every time one is used
[b]Moonlit Night:[/b] Go back to the OG color grading, with lighter shadows and higher saturation

[h2]Emotes[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020566/284ba0327eb292fed06cb3e7c34ce4153a72f73b.png[/img]
There are now 6 different Emotes for the humans!

They can be accessed by opening the Emote wheel and using your mouse or joystick to select an emote (default keybinding: B)


[b]Full change list:[/b]
[list]
🎉 Shading has been changed heavily to decrease brightness of shadows and overall saturation
🎉 New Mirror modulator
🎉 New Shrinked Humans modulator
🎉 New Shuffle Abilities modulator
🎉 New Moonlit Night modulator (returns shading to the OG look)
🎉 6 Emotes (default keybinding: B)
🎉 New masks
🔧 The area around the monster player is brighter to make it easier to see
🔧 Players, NPCs and Items now stay during the game over screen
🔧 Improved ability selection UI slightly
🔧 Added a local savegame backup system
[/list]

notes.title: v0.31.9 - Replay System and New Demo Content!
notes.content:
New round history system, replays, player stats and new demo content!

[h2]The Flashbang and Eye in The Wall ability are now in the demo![/h2]
To celebrate Midnight Mayhem being featured in the Four is a Party – Multiplayer Celebration event! [b](until 16 Dec)[/b]

[h2]Replays & Round History (Beta):[/h2]
[list]
🎉 View a history of all the rounds you played along with a bunch of relevant info
🎉 Save Replays at the end of each round then view them in round history!
🎉 Player stats can be viewed when the game is over, distance travelled, times died, gadgets used etc...
🎉 Players can get a "Trait" at the end of each round, for example for using the most gadgets. For now this only works with humans, this will be changed soon
🔧 You can turn Replays off completely in Graphics settings to reduce overhead
[/list]
*Note, Replays support viewing from the players perspectives, enabling the in-game hud, freecam, controls like fast forward, pause and reset but it does not support scrubbing. 
Making scrubbing work would be a massive time investment as a solo dev and I think I can create much more interesting content for Midnight Mayhem in that time.

[list]
🔧 Fixed issue where the monster would stop moving after selecting ability, having to release and press the key again
🔧 Fixed the stalking meter glowing at the start of the game
🔧 Fixed being able to use stash while aiming flashbang
🔧 Fixed getting an impulse due to Firework Launcher when trapped in Bear Trap
🔧 Fixed being able to interact with stash while in Bear Trap
[/list]

Let me know what you think of the new features, I really think they'll improve the overall experience - have a great day!

notes.title: Steam Deck compatibility
notes.content:
[h2]About Half Rate Shading[/h2]
Midnight Mayhem supports Half Rate Shading but it affects how the game looks quite heavily! 

Volumetrics and translucent surfaces will look blockier and the overall image will look slightly different due to post processing.

If you're unsure whether to use it or not, just look at the game with Half Rate Shading on/off (make sure to restart the game)

[h2]Graphics Preset[/h2]
On Steam Deck Midnight Mayhem will default to a graphics preset specially made for the Steam Deck, this will balance performance and graphical fidelity. You are free to customize the graphics settings any way you like.

I will keep this updated with news around Steam Deck support, if you have any issues you can also reply here.
